description: Pull data from a table. Provide tableId and a "variables" map of {variableCode: valueOrValues}, using codes/ids from table_info. Each value may be a single id, an array of ids, or "*" for all. Omitted variables that allow elimination are aggregated to total. format "JSONSTAT" (default, structured JSON-stat) or "BULK"/"CSV" (semicolon-delimited text).

variables.description: Map of variable code -> value(s). Value is a string, an array of strings, or "*". Example: {"OMRÅDE":"000","Tid":["2024K1","2024K2"],"ALDER":"IALT"}.
